subject: general
question: Which of the following states stands at number one in terms of route kilometers at the end of the year 2019-20 as per the Indian Railways Yearbook 2019-20?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Uttar Pradesh.**__

__
 
• **Uttar Pradesh** stands at number one in terms of route kilometres at the end of the year 2019-20 as per the Indian Railways Yearbook 2019-20.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__

__
 
• In India, the largest route kilometres are in Uttar Pradesh with 8726 kilometres.
 
• This comes out to be 13.6% of India's total Route Kilometers.
 
• After Uttar Pradesh,** Rajasthan **stands out as number 2 in terms of route kilometres.
 
• **South Coast Railway Zone (SCoR)** has been announced as the newest railway zone of the Indian Railways and is headquartered at Visakhapatnam, Andhra Pradesh.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Indian Railways** is a statutory body under the ownership of the Ministry of Railways, Government of India that operates India's national railway system.
 
• Indian Railways was founded on **6 May 1836.**
 
• It manages the fourth largest national railway system in the world by size, with a total route length of** 67,956 km** as of 31 March 2022.
 
• **Ashwini Vaishnav** is the current minister of Railways. (Aug 2022)
